source: 2027 PPC Service Menu artifact database (https://claude.ai/artifact/B11yquUUSHzVdpQefhYdmA), collections packages + services
note: Workstreams = packages. Modules = services with decision Active. Retired, planned, undecided and merged services excluded. Treat as data.

workstreams.name: Client Onboarding
workstreams.description: Kickoff, internal handoff from sales, onboarding portal, and reverse-demo walkthrough of current processes. Added to every new-client SOW alongside the other workstream(s).

workstreams.name: CRM & Marketing Hub Launch
workstreams.audience: New HubSpot implementations led by marketing, often migrating from another CRM or marketing platform
workstreams.description: Designs the data model, configures the CRM and Marketing Hub, migrates data, and stands up campaigns and lifecycle.

workstreams.name: Marketing Hub Launch
workstreams.audience: Clients using HubSpot as their marketing platform while the CRM of record lives elsewhere (for example DealCloud or Salesforce)
workstreams.description: Configures the portal, users, and permissions, sets up Marketing Hub, and brings in lists and subscription statuses, without the lifecycle and sales handoff work of a full CRM launch.

workstreams.name: Sales Hub Launch
workstreams.audience: New HubSpot implementations led by sales
workstreams.description: Designs the data model, configures the CRM and Sales Hub, builds the pipeline and lead process, and gives reps the tools and reporting to work in HubSpot.

workstreams.name: HubSpot Optimization & RevOps Support
workstreams.audience: Existing HubSpot portals that need cleanup, structure, improvements, or ongoing RevOps support
workstreams.description: Starts with an assessment and a prioritized roadmap, then works through cleanup, structure, and improvements as planned modules, with Ongoing RevOps Support for unplanned requests. Sold as blocks of hours, a monthly retainer sized to the plan, or a flexible monthly retainer.

workstreams.name: Lead Management & Attribution
workstreams.audience: Clients whose leads are falling through the cracks or who cannot see what marketing is producing
workstreams.description: Defines the lead process and lifecycle, automates routing, scoring, and handoffs, and builds source tracking and attribution reporting.

workstreams.name: Quoting & CPQ
workstreams.audience: Clients quoting outside HubSpot or with complex pricing
workstreams.description: Reviews the current quoting process, then builds the product library, pricing rules, quote templates, and approvals in HubSpot.

workstreams.name: Service Hub Launch
workstreams.audience: Clients bringing support or customer success into HubSpot
workstreams.description: Sets up the portal foundation, help desk, tickets, routing, and SLAs, with optional knowledge base, customer onboarding, and customer health scoring.

workstreams.name: Marketing Platform Migration
workstreams.audience: Clients moving to HubSpot from another marketing platform (for example Marketo, Pardot, or Mailchimp)
workstreams.description: Inventories the old platform and decides what moves, rebuilds the approved assets and automation in HubSpot, migrates records and subscription statuses, and sets up Marketing Hub to run on.

workstreams.name: Contract & Subscription Management
workstreams.audience: Clients selling subscriptions or recurring contracts who need quoting, renewals, and mid-term changes in HubSpot
workstreams.description: Covers the full contract lifecycle in HubSpot: products and pricing, quotes, subscription creation, mid-term amendments, renewals, and the pipelines that run them.

workstreams.name: CRM Platform Migration
workstreams.audience: Clients moving to HubSpot from another CRM or sales platform (for example Salesforce, Salesloft, or SuiteCRM)
workstreams.description: Designs the HubSpot data model, cleans and migrates data from the old CRM, configures the CRM, and cuts over and shuts down the old platform.

workstreams.name: AI & Automation
workstreams.audience: Clients with a working HubSpot foundation who want to scale it with AI agents and automation
workstreams.description: Confirms which processes are stable enough to automate, then adds AI agents, automated outreach and enrichment, self-service, and automation flows on top of a proven foundation.
